name.en: The Day the Black Moon Rose II

location.zh: 补充收集：黑月升起之日（二）。若尚未取得，可从第四区实验楼魔剑处回身，经栏杆缺口下到房间，左转进入通道，上台阶后穿过右侧房间，再沿梯子下到实验大厅。沿大型实验容器房的右墙检查，在右侧书桌旁拾取这份文书；完成后返回当前任务路线继续前进。
location.en: Supplemental pickup: The Day the Black Moon Rose II. If it is missing, turn back from the Sector No. 4 laboratory Nexus and drop through the railing gap into the room. Turn left into the passage, go up the steps and through the room on the right, then descend the ladder into the laboratory hall. Follow the right wall of the large specimen-container room and collect the record beside the desk. Return to the current mission route afterward.
